title: Review of c51's reactive-Marangoni negative on fresh seed 43 (m -0.15, the m 0 twin, and m -0.15 at world dt/2): burning spots move at most 1.8 body lengths, the same as without the flow
summary: Labkit re-runs of the finding's world.py on seed 43, 128^2, 600 frames x 25 steps (t=600). Inverse heat-Marangoni flow m -0.15: 16 persistent tracks, 7 persistent splits, generation 1, at most 1.8 body lengths. m 0 twin: 1 persistent track, 12 persistent splits, generation 2, at most 1.8 body lengths. m -0.15 at the world's own dt halved (dt 0.02, 50 steps per frame): 16 persistent tracks, 7 persistent splits, at most 1.8 body lengths. The flow makes the spots longer-lived, but they do not move farther.

observations.M: rerun/seed43_m-0.15/FACTS.md max 1.8 body lengths vs rerun/seed43_m0/FACTS.md max 1.8; dt/2 arm the same (1.8)

seeds_run.result: pass (negative replicates, also at world dt/2)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed at one setting. The flow more than doubles persistent tracks (16 vs 1), which the finding does not report: it stabilises spots without moving them.
